scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 15040 isolated CPU pairs for 63 functions of CRadar, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Padding and uninitialised bytes masked. Limits are declared per function in the function-specific scope and in the bank README. Revalidado el 2026-11-04 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lotes 67 a 89 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos: falsos identicos en la direccion del EXE y en el cuerpo/simbolo de la DLL (ver su README.md).
